title: Akbar Mujhe Abbas ke Lashe Pa Le Chalo
body:
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Chehra mere bhai ka bas ek baar dikhado
1. Paala hai maine usko mere laal ki tarha
Battees baras ka hua mujhse pisar juda
Mujhko mere jawaan ke laashe pa le chalo
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Sunkar salaam ghazi ka ye dil machal gaya
Tooti kamar ko thaam ke bole shahe huda
Khaime me jaake ye meri Zainab ko sunaado
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Akbar mujhe maidaan me lekar chalo beta
Ghode se gira saniye Hyder chalo beta
Laashe ke paas mujhko mere laal bithado
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jo hath aapne mere hatho me diye the
Baba mere Abbas ke wo hath kat gaye
Baazu uthaake ye meri ankho'n se lagaado
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
5.  Zaqmo se choor dekhke Abbas ka laasha
Sarwar ne tadapkar kar Ali Akbar se ye kaha
Beta chacha ko teer se bhalo'n se nikaalo
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Abbas se Hussain ne phir roke ye kaha
Khwaahish hai meri aapse aye jaane murtaza
Ek baar is ghareeb ko bhai to pukaaro
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ammar saif jab ke alam ran se aagaya
Khaimo me ghul utha ke alamdaar margaya
Zainab ne kaha tab Ali Akbar se ye ro ro
<<MINI>>
Akbar mujhe Abbas ke laashe pa le chalo
